note: Two [[register.variable]] entries of register r declare column COL, under the names Col and Other. They differ, so they are not the identical rows that source_rows_duplicated refuses, but both are the record (register r, variable COL) and would mint one accepted-authored case id twice; before the refusal the build aborted with the bare ValueError `source scope case IDs must be unique` (source_scope.py, found by #1275). The refusal names the case, the column and both entries of the authored TOML, which are the first and second [[register.variable]] of the first [[register]].
fails_if: `_compile_thin_register` (curation_compile.py) stops refusing a column that one thin register declares twice, so the build mints the authored case twice and aborts with the unlocated `source scope case IDs must be unique`

sources.description: Authored FK register r (2000-2020), variant v (2010-2018) and two variables, Col and Other, both on column COL. Plus the SCB sample.

files.Forsakringskassan/fk.toml:
[[register]]
key = "r"
name = "R"
valid_from = "2000-01-01"

[[register.variant]]
key = "v"
name = "V"
valid_from = "2010-01-01"
valid_to = "2018-12-31"
[[register.variable]]
name = "Col"
column = "COL"

[[register.variable]]
name = "Other"
column = "COL"

variants = ["v"]

valid_to = "2019-12-31"
